q: How do I book a taxi?
a: Fill in the booking form, call us, or message us on WhatsApp. We agree the fare with you and confirm your booking by phone or WhatsApp.

q: Can I cancel or change a booking?
a: Yes. Call or WhatsApp us. If you cancel at least 6 hours before pickup, you get a refund. Cancellations within 6 hours of pickup are not refunded. See our cancellation and refund policy.

q: How much luggage can I bring?
a: It depends on the vehicle. Each car on the Fleet & Fares page lists its luggage space. If you have more bags than usual, tell us when you book so we can send a bigger vehicle.
